_metadata.description: Synthetic hazard reports for the Awaab's Law triage smoke test
_metadata.landlord: Every tenancy, address and person in this file is invented. Example Court is not a real estate.
_metadata.note: ALL DATA IN THIS FILE IS SYNTHETIC. No real tenant, home or landlord is represented.
_metadata.evaluation_label: MOCK SMOKE TEST. Not a measure of model accuracy.
